# v11.0.0

Arcanic.Result now supports .NET 11.

> **This release contains breaking changes.** Arcanic.Result versions follow the .NET major version (11.x for .NET 11). Read the migration notes below before upgrading from 10.x.

## Breaking changes

### .NET 8 and .NET 9 are no longer supported

The package no longer ships `net8.0` or `net9.0` assemblies. Projects that target .NET 8 or .NET 9 cannot install this version.

**Migration:** move your project to .NET 10 or later. If you have to stay on .NET 8 or .NET 9, keep using Arcanic.Result 10.1.0, which supports them.

The public API has not changed. Code that compiled against 10.1.0 compiles against 11.0.0 without changes.

## Multi-targeting

Targets .NET 10 and .NET 11.
